topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 88 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 18 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (timelockcontroller, erc165, erc721holder). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
